name: Bram
look: A gangly seventeen-year-old with a big nose and an eager grin, a padded jacket two sizes too large, rough brown breeches, and a wooden practice sword at his belt.
personality: Eager, boastful and kind; wants desperately to be a real soldier.
values: courage, Hal's approval, his mother's pride
concerns: Hal says his guard is a disgrace; he wants to show someone he's improving.

shield.text: Hal makes recruits hold the shield up until their arms shake.
shield.line: Hal makes us hold the shield up till our arms fall off. You'll see.
shield.lead: Hal makes recruits hold their shields up until their arms shake.

persuaded_by: being treated like a real soldier

samples: I nearly beat Hal once! Well. I nearly didn't fall over.
Watch his shoulder. That's what he says. I never can.
Are you joining? You should join.
My mother says I'll be a sergeant. Hal laughed.
voice.habits: Boasts, then admits the truth; asks if you're joining.
voice.greeting: Grins: 'Come to learn? Hal's tough. I'm Bram.'

likes: stories of battles, his practice sword
dislikes: cleaning the trough, being called boy

npc_hal_brand.text: terrifying and the best man alive

superstition.text: Bram would want to know how it works.
